name: Label
description: UI text for interactive elements — form labels, button text, navigation items, badges, table headers. Medium or semibold weight by default. Not for body copy (use Paragraph) or headings (use Heading).

size.description: Label size. Maps to text scale tokens.

uppercase.description: Renders text in uppercase with wider letter-spacing. Useful for overlines and category labels.

do: Use Label for button text, nav items, form labels, table headers, badge text
Use uppercase=true for overlines and category labels
Use size='xs' for fine print and metadata
doNot: Do not use Label for body copy — use Paragraph
Do not use Label for page headings — use Heading or Display
